caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical metal lantern with a conical top, rendered in shades of brown and metallic grey. The main body of the lantern features a door on the right side that is slightly open, revealing the interior. The door and the cylindrical walls are perforated with uniform, repeating patterns of slits and small circular holes, and the conical top is decorated with similar punched designs. Inside the lantern, a red candle with a visible wick and partially melted top is situated in the center, resting on a flat circular base. There is a latch on the right side of the door. In the top left corner of the image, there is a small inset line drawing of the same lantern, shown closed with a focus on the overall shape and design patterns. The drawing is set against a plain, unadorned background.
title: Candle Lantern
